body:
### Area

VS Code or editor integration

### Version

0.566.0

### Minimal reproduction

Workspace: a Nuxt 4 / Vue 3.5 application with 487 SFCs and ~1,430 `.ts` files (1,901 files in the checked tsconfig). `vize check` on it finds real template type errors (for example a `Ref<T[]>` parameter receiving the unwrapped array from a template handler, TS2739).

Drive `vize lsp --stdio` with a plain JSON-RPC client (no editor involved):

1. `initialize` with `initializationOptions: { lint: true, typecheck: true, editor: true, ecosystem: true }`, then `initialized`.
2. `textDocument/didOpen` on a component whose template `vize check` reports 8 × TS2739 for.
3. Collect `textDocument/publishDiagnostics` for 60 s.

```text
+514ms    3 diags  {"vize/lint:vue/no-inline-style":3}
+11721ms  4 diags  {"vize/lint:vue/no-inline-style":3,"vize/types:typecheck-timed-out":1}
```

A second file opened right after gets its `typecheck-timed-out` at +23.8 s, i.e. every file waits for the same ~10 s budget and gives up.

With `VIZE_LSP_NATIVE_DIAGNOSTIC_TIMEOUT_MS=180000`:

```text
+466ms    3 diags  {"vize/lint:vue/no-inline-style":3}
+58677ms 13 diags  {"vize/lint:vue/no-inline-style":3,"vize/types:6133":2,"vize/types:2739":8}
```

So the checker does finish and agrees with `vize check`; it only needs about a minute for the first project warm-up on this machine (12 cores, load was high).

### Actual behavior

With the default budget the editor never shows a single type error for this project: every file ends with `vize/types:typecheck-timed-out`. Nothing tells the user that raising `VIZE_LSP_NATIVE_DIAGNOSTIC_TIMEOUT_MS` would help, and the VS Code extension exposes no setting for it (`vize.typecheck.enable` is the only knob).

### Expected behavior

- Do not drop the result after a fixed budget: keep the project warm-up running in the background and publish the type diagnostics when they arrive (lint diagnostics already arrive in ~0.5 s, so the two can be published separately).
- Scale the budget with project size, or at least make it configurable from the editor (`vize.typecheck.timeoutMs` or similar) and say in the diagnostic how to raise it.
- Ideally reuse the warm state across files so the second file does not pay the same ~10 s.

### Environment

- OS: macOS 15 (Darwin 25.6.0)
- Architecture: arm64 (Apple M2 Max, 12 cores)
- Node.js: 25.8.1
- Package manager: pnpm 12.8.1 (via Vite+ 0.2.7)
- Rust: n/a (npm packages)
- Framework: Vue 3.5.42, Nuxt 4.5.2, Vite 8.2.2, vize / @vizejs/* 0.566.0 (bundled TypeScript 7.0.2)

### Before submitting

- [x] I checked existing fix reports and pull requests.
- [x] This is not a private security report.
title: fix(maestro): native typecheck diagnostics time out after ~10 s in a ~1,900-file workspace, so template type errors never reach the editor
